source_schedule.scope: planned source arrivals minus socket-accepted sends; synchronous send intervals are sampled before/after, not per record

target_acceptance.scope: this finite run and hardware only, not an unbounded capacity proof

finite_supply_validation.scope: one local synthetic 15-second offered workload; not long-term or production capacity

store.backend_lookup_metric_scope: workload only, excluding recovery/export; lookup_calls counts persisted digest-prefix candidate Seeks (one per distinct digest per batch); candidates counts persisted payload rows returned for C++ exact comparison; pending hits are separately counted by rocksdb_dedup_pending_hits
store.deduplication: nonunique fixed32 SHA-256 prefix candidates, exact full canonical byte equality only; pending batch cache
store.digest_cache_contract: shared store_digest; trusted EncodedRecord SHA256 only while bytes unchanged; test override takes precedence
store.durability_scope: synchronous WAL atomic WriteBatch with OS sync; no physical power-loss or hardware PLP claim
store.heavy_equivalence: logical per-record time/symbol secondary index and attempted/inserted/ignored/bytes batch metadata; Rocks KV and SQLite B-tree layouts/physical costs are not identical; no segment CRC substitute
store.input_validation: same trusted-codec canonical header/64MiB batch boundary as SQLite; recovery fully decodes all payloads and validates both directions of every index
store.payload_location: RocksDB D values contain complete canonical records; no external segment files
store.persisted_count_scope: strictly verified recovery state plus acknowledged atomic batches; null when poisoned because write status may have an uncertain commit outcome

rocksdb.api_count_scope: logical library operations, not syscalls; successful workload batch Put/key/value bytes exclude startup stamp/state; dedup and range iterators reused per operation; recovery has separate Get/iterator counters
rocksdb.finish_contract: Flush(wait), WaitForCompact(flush,wait_for_purge), SyncWAL, Close/delete, read-only reopen all timed inside finish; export does not write or repair

options.option_policy: library cache/memtable defaults; explicit sync/checksum/recovery/no-compression plus capped33 prefix and 10-bit/key Bloom; actual memory including Bloom is not claimed equal to SQLite cache budget

rocksdb.sync_source: POSIX use_fsync=true; macOS HAVE_FULLFSYNC builds select fcntl(F_FULLFSYNC), otherwise fsync; build capability is not inferred from use_fsync

store.schema_cost: per unique record: D digest/id -> full payload and R symbol/time/id -> digest; one S state replacement per nonempty batch
store.writer_model: one DB writer handle; mutex covers dedup read through synchronous WriteBatch; DB LOCK rejects independent writers; not TransactionDB or multi-writer transactions

full_path_store.backend_lookup_metric_scope: workload only, excluding recovery/export; lookup_calls counts candidate SQL executions (including the original INSERT subquery); candidates counts rows returned for C++ exact comparison, not SQLite internal visits; backend_candidates_observable=0 means internal subquery candidates are unavailable, not measured zero
full_path_store.compact_lookup_algorithm: prepared digest-candidate SELECT; exact canonical byte comparison in C++; reset/clear lookup before prepared INSERT VALUES; both inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE
full_path_store.deduplication: nonunique fixed32 SHA-256 candidates then exact full payload comparison; separate prepared SELECT and INSERT VALUES within BEGIN IMMEDIATE
full_path_store.digest_cache_contract: private trusted EncodedRecord.sha256 valid only while canonical bytes unchanged; missing SHA-256 computed and separately timed/counted; test override takes precedence
full_path_store.durability_scope: SQLite FULL WAL commit with OS sync; no physical PLP claim
full_path_store.lookup_metric_scope: sqlite_lookup_*_calls are subsets of aggregate sqlite_* workload API counters, not additional calls to add again; lookup prepare/step timings are subsets of aggregate prepare/step, while bind/reset/clear are independently timed; prepare includes open-time lifetime reuse; step counts each ROW/DONE/error sqlite3_step; rows counts record lookups and candidate_bytes counts returned canonical bytes, not physical I/O; library APIs are not syscalls
full_path_store.prepare_metric_scope: sqlite_prepare measures workload INSERT/metadata and digest-candidate lookup SELECT prepares, including open-time lifetime reuse; sqlite_lookup_prepare is a subset; export/recovery/schema prepares excluded
full_path_store.schema_cost: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY payload table; fixed32 nonunique digest index and symbol/time indexes contain rowid only; no UNIQUE(digest,payload)

schema: CREATE TABLE records(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload BLOB NOT NULL, symbol TEXT NOT NULL, time BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(time)='blob' AND length(time)=8), digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(digest)='blob' AND length(digest)=32))

full_path_store.sqlite_api_count_scope: library API calls, NOT syscalls/kernel calls; begin/commit count sqlite3_exec calls in the same scope as corresponding Timer counts; prepare/step count workload API scope (including separate lookup when selected); bind/reset/clear_bindings/changes and error rollback/cleanup count workload API invocations; schema, recovery and export APIs excluded; no per-record JSON logging
full_path_store.statement_reuse_scope: store lifetime, prepared at open; reset/rebind within each batch
